description: This file defines the IncentiveDTO class, which is a Data Transfer Object used to encapsulate incentive-related data for clients within the interest rate chart incentive module of the project.

classes.name: IncentiveDTO
classes.description: A simple data container class holding a client reference, interest amount, and incentive details.

methods.name: IncentiveDTO
methods.description: Constructor for IncentiveDTO, initializes client, interest, and incentives fields.

methods.name: client
methods.description: Returns the client associated with this incentive.

methods.name: interest
methods.description: Returns the interest amount associated with this incentive.
